defects.trigger: applyRate(cents, basisPoints) called with basisPoints > 10000 (rate above 100%), e.g. applyRate(100, 10001) or applyRate(100, 20000)
defects.reason: Acceptance condition 5 requires applyRate to reject basisPoints > 10000 with a TypeError. The only basisPoints validation present is `if (!Number.isSafeInteger(basisPoints) || basisPoints < 0) throw new TypeError('basisPoints must be a non-negative safe integer');`; there is no upper bound check. Observed behaviour from the candidate blob (735668b:src/invoice.mjs): applyRate(100000, 10001) => 100010, applyRate(100, 20000) => 200, applyRate(100, 10001) => 100 — all return numbers instead of throwing TypeError.
defects.impact: Rate values above 100% are silently accepted and applied, violating the authoritative validation contract. tools/accept.mjs does not currently exercise this case, so the acceptance gate still exits 0 and cannot catch this defect.
evidence: git cat-file -p 735668b:src/invoice.mjs | grep -n basisPoints => '31:  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(basisPoints) || basisPoints < 0) {' / '32:    throw new TypeError("basisPoints must be a non-negative safe integer");' / '34:  const numerator = cents * basisPoints;' (no >10000 guard)
